To calculate the total for the supply order, I need to identify the line items and their associated costs.

Looking back at the conversation history provided, I see various updates regarding:
- Preferences for rooms (harbour room, garden studio, north office, etc.)
- Reminders about people (Ada, Teo, Finn, Wren)
- Status of facilities (coffee machines, lifts, repainting)
- Scheduling changes (stand-ups, desk swaps)
- One mention of a return: "Take 25 off the order for the returned stock."

However, there are no initial line items with prices or quantities listed in the previous messages. The only monetary value mentioned is a deduction of 25 for returned stock. Without the base order items to which this deduction applies, or any other itemized costs, I cannot calculate a subtotal.

It appears that the supply order lines have not yet been provided in this session. Could you please list the items and their costs so I can add them up for you?
